resources.string:
SandFly yisifundi sesikrini esihloselwe izimo noma abantu abanobunzima bokubona isikrini. Ikunikeza impendulo ekhulunyiwe ukuze ukwazi ukusebenzisa idivayisi yakho ngaphandle kokubheka isikrini.

Uma SandFly ivuliwe, into egxilile esikrinini ikhulunyelwa phezulu.

Ukuswayiphela kwesokudla kuzoya entweni elandelayo, futhi ukuswayiphela kwesokunxele kuzoya entweni edlule.

Swayipha khona manje ukuze uthole inkinobho elandelayo.
